answer_1.quote: Our main evaluation task, we focus on paraphrase generation ... We also conducted experiments on lexically constrained machine translation ... and on image captioning (MSCOCO) as paraphrase pairs.
answer_1.outputs: paraphrased sentences, translated sentences with constraints, generated captions

answer_2.quote: We choose BERT-iBLEU as the utility u(·), that is, both for evaluating the model performance and for rewarding the model during training. We also report BLEU, ParaScore, CSR, and BLEU•CSR scores.

answer_4.quote: We performed example-wise comparison between randomly chosen outputs of PPR and BRIO/MLE trained models (generated by beam search with beam size of 16), asking the annotators to decide which one is a better paraphrase of the given source sentence, or if they are comparable in terms of faithfulness, lexical divergence and fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to choose the better paraphrase or indicate if they were comparable, based on faithfulness, lexical divergence, and fluency.
